atoms.exact_source_text: A companion architecture to the v0.5 Home Mode, Colony, and DWELL Specification.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away is described as a companion architecture to the v0.5 Home Mode, Colony, and DWELL Specification.

atoms.exact_source_text: This document revises the Away material developed in the v0.4.7 decisions log under the governing premise that Home grows the Colony and Away grows, hazards, and changes particular Citizens.
atoms.normalized_claim: The document revises Away material from a v0.4.7 decisions log under the governing premise that Home grows the Colony while Away grows, hazards, and changes particular Citizens.

atoms.exact_source_text: At Home, a Citizen is one equal share of civic commitment. Away, that same Citizen becomes an individually resolved bearer of capability, history, equipment, Exposure, and consequence.
atoms.normalized_claim: The canonical premise states that at Home a Citizen is one equal share of civic commitment, while Away that same Citizen becomes an individually resolved bearer of capability, history, equipment, Exposure, and consequence.
